annotations.text: Pick a wordmark (A, B or C). The icon in C is the app icon, favicon and Squad tab icon. Nothing else on the brand board needs a decision.

NEW — the squad gets a name on day one.
Replaces "Guest-7F2A" everywhere: posts, ladder, share card. Three suggestions plus Shuffle so a kid never faces an empty box. Skip keeps the old guest label.
Header now leads with squad size ("squad 2 of 18"), not level. Posts are "by Hill Runners". Bing's comment says "in your squad".
Kicker becomes SQUAD +1. Body names the whole squad so far. Same button: Snap with Bing.
Crew tab renamed Squad. Header: squad name, "Squad of 2". Everything else is the built screen.
